question: What is the monthly fee for the Everyday Current Account?
expected_answer: The Everyday Current Account costs AED 25 per month. The fee is waived with an average monthly balance of AED 5,000 or more, or a monthly salary of at least AED 8,000.
answer: The monthly maintenance fee for the Everyday Current Account is AED 25. However, this fee is waived when the average monthly balance is AED 5,000 or more, or when a salary of at least AED 8,000 is credited to the account each month. [1]
contexts:
NovaBank: Fees and Charges - Account maintenance fees

The Everyday Current Account has a monthly maintenance fee of AED 25. The fee is waived when the average monthly balance is AED 5,000 or more, or when a salary of at least AED 8,000 is credited to the account each month.

The Smart Savings Account has no monthly maintenance fee.

The Premier Account has a monthly fee of AED 150, which is waived when the customer holds combined balances of AED 150,000 or more with NovaBank.

NovaBank: Transfers and Limits - Daily transfer limits

The default daily limit for transfers through the mobile app and online banking is AED 50,000 per customer, across all accounts.

Customers can raise the daily limit up to AED 250,000 from the app under Settings > Limits. Any increase requires one-time-password (OTP) confirmation, and the new limit becomes active after a 12-hour cooling-off period.

Transfers to a newly added beneficiary are limited to AED 10,000 during the first 24 hours after the beneficiary is added.

NovaBank: Accounts and KYC - Savings interest

The Smart Savings Account pays 3.25% annual interest, calculated on the daily balance and credited monthly. The rate is variable and may change with 30 days' notice.

NovaBank: Fees and Charges - Card fees

The NovaBank Classic debit card is free. A replacement card costs AED 35, except when the card is replaced because of suspected fraud, in which case it is free.

Foreign currency card transactions carry a 2.5% cross-border fee.

question: What is the charge for an unarranged overdraft?
expected_answer: AED 50 per occurrence, charged at most once per calendar day.
answer: According to NovaBank's fees and charges, an unarranged overdraft is charged at AED 50 per occurrence, at most once per calendar day. [1]
contexts:
NovaBank: Fees and Charges - Overdraft and late charges

Unarranged overdraft is charged at AED 50 per occurrence, at most once per calendar day.

A returned cheque due to insufficient funds incurs a fee of AED 200.

NovaBank: Fees and Charges - Card fees

The NovaBank Classic debit card is free. A replacement card costs AED 35, except when the card is replaced because of suspected fraud, in which case it is free.

Foreign currency card transactions carry a 2.5% cross-border fee.

NovaBank: Fees and Charges - Transfer fees

Transfers between two NovaBank accounts are free of charge.

Local transfers to other UAE banks cost AED 2 per transfer when made through the mobile app or online banking, and AED 10 when requested at a branch.

International transfers (SWIFT) cost AED 30 per transfer. Correspondent bank charges may be deducted by intermediary banks and are outside NovaBank's control.

NovaBank: Cards - Lost or stolen cards

If a card is lost or stolen, the customer should freeze it immediately in the mobile app under Cards > Freeze card, or call the 24/7 helpline on 800-NOVA.

A frozen card can be unfrozen at any time from the app. If the card is reported as stolen, it is permanently blocked and a replacement card is issued free of charge.

Customers are not liable for unauthorised transactions made after the card was reported lost or stolen.

NovaBank: Transfers and Limits - Processing times

Transfers between NovaBank accounts are instant, 24/7.

Local transfers to other UAE banks made before 2:00 PM on a business day are credited the same day. Transfers made after 2:00 PM, or on weekends and public holidays, are processed on the next business day.

NovaBank: Transfers and Limits - Cancelling a transfer

Instant transfers between NovaBank accounts cannot be cancelled once confirmed.

A scheduled transfer can be cancelled from the app until 11:59 PM on the day before its execution date.

To recall an international transfer that has already been sent, the customer must contact the call centre. A recall is not guaranteed and a recall fee of AED 50 applies.

NovaBank: Transfers and Limits - Beneficiaries

Customers can add up to 100 beneficiaries. Adding a beneficiary requires OTP confirmation. The IBAN of a UAE beneficiary must start with "AE" and contain 23 characters.
